thicken_voxel_shape: thicken a 3D voxel shape by expanding each block outward by a given delta
scale_voxel_shape: scale a 3D voxel shape up by specified factors along each axis
rotate_voxel_shape: rotate a 3D voxel shape by 90-degree increments on a specified plane
replace_blocks_by_type: replace blocks of a specific type with a new block type in a voxel shape
fill_flat_voxel_shape: fill gaps between connected blocks along x, y, or z axes in a voxel shape
